definitions.explanation: One's mental attitude or approach toward doing something properly. Refers to the conscious effort to keep something in mind and act accordingly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日頃|ひごろ}→日頃：07284_higoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{心掛|こころが}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{心掛|こころが}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I make an effort to maintain good health habits.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{心掛|こころが}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
FORMATION:
{心|こころ} (heart/mind) + {掛|か}け (hanging on, keeping)
→ Something kept in one's mind/heart

RELATED VERB:
⟦{心掛|こころが}ける→心掛ける：noentry⟧ - to keep in mind, to try to, to make a point of
・⟦{早|はや}く→早く：02935_hayaku⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦よう→よう：01114_you⟧⟦{心掛|こころが}けている→心掛ける：noentry⟧ (I make a point of going to bed early)

USAGE:
・⟦{日頃|ひごろ}→日頃：07284_higoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{心掛|こころが}け - everyday attitude, habits
・⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{心掛|こころが}け - good intentions, a good attitude
・{心掛|こころが}け⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ - it depends on one's attitude

NUANCE:
Refers not just to intentions but to the conscious effort to maintain a certain attitude or practice habitually. Often used when praising someone's diligence or discipline.

・⟦{心得|こころえ}→心得：07465_kokoroe⟧ - knowledge, understanding, rules to follow
・⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ - posture; attitude (figurative)
